checks.name: S1
checks.desc: FDiff invariance of the P action, 4 (eta,gamma) pairs, |dS|/S
checks.why: if a symmetry related eta and gamma the pairs with eta != gamma would fail

checks.name: S1b
checks.desc: the residual does not grow when eta != gamma (max_off/max_same)
checks.why: an O(lambda) term proportional to (eta-gamma) is what a forced relation looks like

checks.name: S2
checks.desc: quadratic scaling of the FDiff residual (lam 2x)
checks.why: a first-order residual would mean it is not a symmetry at all

checks.name: S3
checks.desc: the four (eta,gamma) pairs give four distinct c_T^2
checks.why: the map (eta,gamma)->(eta,gamma/eta) has Jacobian 1/eta != 0 (A68 D10)

checks.name: S4
checks.desc: shift variation per unit volume = -a0 |c|
checks.why: W(u) = u^2/(2K)+... is not shift invariant: the quadratic term is a mass K/2

checks.name: S5
checks.desc: the shift variation is nonzero (no shift symmetry)
checks.why: a shift symmetry would need W' = 0, i.e. u = 0 everywhere

checks.name: S6
checks.desc: d^2W/dP^2 at P=0 equals K (the shift-breaking mass term)
checks.why: W = u^2/(2K)+... with u=K|P| gives (K/2)|P|^2, i.e. m^2 = K/eta

checks.name: S7
checks.desc: Weyl exponents of the four P operators (4D measure included)
checks.why: the three derivative operators share 2w; the clock term is w+2

checks.name: S8
checks.desc: min_w max|exponent| : no w makes the P action Weyl flat
checks.why: 2w = 0 needs w = 0, w + 2 = 0 needs w = -2: inconsistent

checks.name: S9
checks.desc: gamma/eta is Weyl invariant (equal exponents)
checks.why: a common rescaling cannot fix a ratio

checks.name: S10
checks.desc: on-shell conservation residual, 4 (eta,gamma) pairs
checks.why: the residual is Pdot.EOM: an identity, not a relation between eta and gamma

checks.name: S11
checks.desc: d_tT00+d_iT0i = Pdot.EOM (Noether identity), independent computation
checks.why: shows the conservation law is an identity for every eta, gamma

checks.name: O1
checks.desc: gamma/eta = m_T^2 L*^2/2
checks.why: so measuring the P-mode range measures c_T^2

checks.name: O3
checks.desc: w = p/rho scales linearly in eps (dust at O(eps))
checks.why: c_s^2 = dp/drho -> 0 as eps -> 0; gamma/eta is NOT the medium's sound speed

checks.name: O4
checks.desc: elastic speed reproduces 0.72 m/s
checks.why: independent check of gamma and of the identification D.P <-> rho_c

checks.name: O5
checks.desc: c_s=0 growth = exact LCDM growth function
checks.why: validates the ODE before it is used for the bound

checks.name: O6
checks.desc: 1-S ~ k^2 in the weak-pressure limit
checks.why: the pressure term is c_s^2 k^2/(a^2 H^2): a wrong coefficient breaks the slope

checks.name: O7
checks.desc: the quoted bound reproduces S=0.95 at k=0.2 h/Mpc
checks.why: the bound must be the computed one, not a declared number

checks.name: O7b
checks.desc: bound at k=0.5 h/Mpc reproduces S=0.95
checks.why: quotes the second end of the LSS range, not an assumed number

checks.name: O8
checks.desc: lambda_C = L*/(sqrt(2 c_T^2)) identity
checks.why: independent route to the same range

checks.name: O9
checks.desc: sigma_c = sqrt(a0 L*) in km/s
checks.why: the cold sector's dispersion is not a function of eta

checks.name: O10
checks.desc: growth with the elastic speed is un-suppressed
checks.why: c_s,el^2 = 2.9e-18: the dark sector is dust, so gamma/eta does not enter growth

checks.name: O11
checks.desc: k_J ~ sqrt(rho): cluster/mean ratio
checks.why: checks the Jeans formula used for the cluster bound

checks.name: O12
checks.desc: dark-sector w at recombination scales as (1+z)^3
checks.why: a constant c_T^2 would not scale this way: the CMB sees no gamma/eta

checks.name: O13
checks.desc: d(omega^2)/dk^2 = 1 for the TT mode (c_T^2 = 1)
checks.why: gamma/eta cannot enter: helicity-2 has no P operator

checks.name: O14
checks.desc: P-background graviton mass vs LIGO bound
checks.why: 11 orders below the bound: invisible

checks.name: O15
checks.desc: loop correction to c_T^2
checks.why: no mixing at O(m_T^2): the P-TT vertex is cubic

checks.name: O16
checks.desc: Delta N_eff for two thermalized bosonic modes
checks.why: Planck's Delta N_eff < 0.34 would exclude it: the modes must be unpopulated

checks.name: G1
checks.desc: Pi_gamma/Pi_W = (1-x)L*^2/r^2 = 1/2 at r = L*
checks.why: the gradient quadrupole is the same order as the potential one, and eta-free

checks.name: G2
checks.desc: gradient-sector quadrupole/trace vanishes for P ~ x
checks.why: Pi_ij = -gamma d (P'-P/r)(n_i n_j - delta_ij/3): a real O(eps^2) object

checks.name: G3
checks.desc: computed quadrupole = -gamma d (P'-P/r)(n_i n_j - delta/3)
checks.why: independent evaluation of the same tensor

checks.name: G4
checks.desc: c_T^2(TT) at gamma/eta=0.001
checks.why: the P sector has no TT coupling

checks.name: G4b
checks.desc: c_T^2(TT) at gamma/eta=100.0
checks.why: the P sector has no TT coupling

checks.name: G5
checks.desc: alpha_1 = 2r^2/L*^2 = r^2 K/gamma
checks.why: uses L*^2=2gamma/K

checks.name: G6
checks.desc: alpha_1 is eta-independent (no time derivative in the static solution)
checks.why: alpha_1 is built from the charge, not from E_i

checks.name: G7
checks.desc: alpha_1 ~ 1/gamma (varying gamma by 4x)
checks.why: L* is measured, so this is a check of the gamma dependence, not of eta

checks.name: G8
checks.desc: momentum density j_P = 0 for E = 0, three eta values
checks.why: alpha_2 = 0 structurally; the coefficient eta never gets a chance to act

checks.name: G9
checks.desc: healthy (Z,omega^2,m_T^2 > 0) on 24 (beta, gamma/eta) points
checks.why: the conditions are beta>0, eta>0, gamma>0: no condition on gamma/eta

checks.name: G10
checks.desc: eta_max = beta K/(2 a0^2) inverted back
checks.why: the bound is on eta alone, not on the ratio

checks.name: G11
checks.desc: three widely spaced gamma/eta survive all four gates
checks.why: no gate fixes the ratio: the surviving set is an open interval

checks.name: C1a
checks.desc: UV limit c_s^2 = alpha/eta = gamma/eta at gamma/eta=0.37
checks.why: at high p the conformal term B is negligible: the scalar joins the medium

checks.name: C1
checks.desc: UV limit c_s^2 = alpha/eta = gamma/eta at gamma/eta=1.0
checks.why: at high p the conformal term B is negligible: the scalar joins the medium

checks.name: C1b
checks.desc: UV limit c_s^2 = alpha/eta = gamma/eta at gamma/eta=100.0
checks.why: at high p the conformal term B is negligible: the scalar joins the medium

checks.name: C2
checks.desc: two independent routes to p_sc (IR branch)
checks.why: one uses (K,a0,alpha), the other (K,a0,L*) with alpha = K L*^2/2

checks.name: C3
checks.desc: degeneracy check
checks.why: same number

checks.name: C4
checks.desc: the two branches agree within a factor 2 at eta = gamma
checks.why: at eta=gamma both reduce to O(1) K^(1/2)/(a0 L*^3)

checks.name: C5
checks.why: the parametric form, checked against an independent algebraic route

checks.name: C6
checks.desc: p_sc/H0
checks.why: 36 orders below Hubble

checks.name: C7
checks.desc: p_sc/a0
checks.why: 35 orders below a0

checks.name: C8
checks.why: 44 orders below the fitted stiffness scale

checks.name: C9
checks.desc: largest loop factor over CMB/LSS/galactic/L*/a0 scales
checks.why: the EFT is perturbative at every astrophysical scale by >30 orders

checks.name: C10
checks.desc: nabla^2(-r/8pi) = -1/(4 pi r) pointwise
checks.why: the k^4 Green's function is the potential of a delta source

checks.name: C11
checks.desc: unit flux: nabla^4(-r/8pi) = delta^3(r)
checks.why: normalisation of the linear potential (Gauss)

checks.name: C12
checks.desc: d(-G)/dr = 1/(8 pi): constant force
checks.why: wrong shape for a 1/r potential

checks.name: C13
checks.desc: linear/Newtonian = (r/L*)^2 = 1 at r = L*
checks.why: A22's exact solution

checks.name: C14
checks.desc: p_sc a0 = const across the three footings
checks.why: p_sc scales as 1/a0, so the kappa error bar moves it by 1/kappa
